detail.answer: I want a few changes. Call the ini setting junit_output_limit. Default 0 means unlimited. Positive values keep the first N Unicode code points of each raw captured stdout, stderr and log section independently, before adding headers or XML escaping. If cut, append a newline, [... output truncated ...], then a newline; the marker and header do not count toward N. No tail retention. Apply this equally to passing and failing tests' captured streams. Preserve the complete failure/error traceback diagnostics, and preserve existing junit_logging and junit_log_passing_tests filtering. Reject negative and non-integer settings with a clear configuration error. This keeps CI output bounded without hiding why a test failed.

+    tracebacks are added, so the final written content can still exceed the
